problem.ttile: Disciplinary issues demand real attention—not just another email thread

list.list: Cases managed through emails and calls — no centralized record, no consistent process
No visibility on case status—HR teams can’t see who’s responsible for the next step
Notices drafted each time manually—show cause notices, warning letters, charge sheets - created inconsistently
No Paper Trail, No Accountability—Haphazard document management due to missing email trails, non-responses, delayed responses, etc.
Decisions Made, Proof Missing—When an employee challenges a decision, the case history has to be reconstructed from multiple email threads.
No Deadlines, No Escalations, No Urgency—Unable to set any turnaround time for every step of the process, as communication is done via emails

how_it_works.title: All stakeholders. One tool.
how_it_works.description: Disciplinary cases involve multiple stakeholders across departments and locations. The tool gives each of them role-based access — keeping everyone aligned while eliminating back-and-forth communication.

list.list: Initiator(Logs & Reports): Raise the case with incident details, supporting documents, and severity indication.
Corporate HR(Reviews and escalates): Assesses severity, routes to regional HR, oversees policy compliance, and authorizes final action.
Regional HR(Coordinates Locally): Formally notifies the employee and manages the show cause notice process and coordinates the local investigation.
Disciplinary Committee(Deliberates & Decides): Reviews evidence, conducts cross-examination if needed, and reaches a final, documented verdict.
Legal Team(Validates Legally): Consulted for high-severity cases to ensure legal formalities are complete before action is executed.
Employee(Responds & Appeals): Receives formal communications, submits responses and evidence, and can formally appeal the verdict.

how_it_works.title: From complaint to closure, every step is tracked.
how_it_works.description: The process is structured but not rigid. Every step can be configured to match your HR policy, escalation rules, and approval hierarchy.

list.list: The initiator logs the complaint—a case is registered with a unique ID, incident details, date, parties involved, and initial severity. Immediately visible to Corporate HR.
Corporate HR reviews severity—HR assesses the case, determines the severity level, and routes it to the appropriate regional HR team for local coordination.
Regional HR formally notifies the employee; case details are shared with the employee. A show-cause notice or charge sheet is auto-generated and served digitally.
Employee responds or appeals—The employee submits their response and supporting evidence. They can accept the finding or formally appeal for further discussion.
The Disciplinary Committee deliberates—the committee reviews all evidence, conducts cross-examination if required, and reaches a final verdict—fully documented.
Legal clearance for high-severity cases—The legal team confirms all formalities are complete before HR executes the final action.
HR executes action depending on the severity and outcome: a warning letter, suspension, or dismissal. All actions are generated, stored, and logged automatically.

key_features.title: Built for every stage of the disciplinary process.
key_features.description: From the first complaint log to the final action letter, the tool handles the entire lifecycle so your HR team can focus on judgment, not administration.

list.feature: Centralized creation and tracking of disciplinary cases with unique case IDs, incident details, and real-time status visibility. Every case has a clear owner from day one.
Rule-based, multi-level approval workflows mapped to action type, case severity, employee grade, and department. The right people get the right case at the right time—automatically.
Standardized, template-driven generation of Show Cause Notices (SCN), warning letters, and charge sheets. Consistent, professional, and stored securely — no more manual drafting every time.
Structured mechanism for employee replies, evidence submission, investigator assignment, and investigation logs. Every exchange is documented, timestamped, and retrievable.
End-to-end, tamper-proof audit trail of all actions, approvals, and communications — ensuring full legal and regulatory compliance and making every decision defensible.
Real-time dashboards and reports on open and closed cases, delays, trends, and SLA adherence — giving management the oversight they need without asking for it.

overview.title: End-to-end CSR handling in 0ne platform
overview.description: From proposal to closure, every part of the CSR lifecycle is covered, connected, and auditable. Nothing moves forward without a complete record at each stage.

list.list: Register the NGO Partner: Before a project can begin, the NGO partner must be registered and verified. Every project ties to a documented partner — no unvalidated associations. [Create Partner · Edit details · Project linkage]

Create the Project & Save as Draft: Project details are filled in and saved as a draft. The team can continue editing before final submission—each project carries its partner details, budget, documents, and full status history. [In Draft · Update Projects]
Add Budget & Upload Documents: Budget details and supporting documents are entered and stored securely against the project record before submission.

Submit for Approval: Once complete, the proposal is formally submitted. A unique project ID is generated, and the multi-level approval flow begins automatically. [Proposal review · Approval flow · Rejection with remarks]

Regional Execution via PSN: Approved projects are distributed to regional implementation units (PSNs) under the master project—each with its own budget, details, and tracking. [Create PSN · View PSN · Region-level tracking]
Project Closure: Once the initiative is completed, the project is marked closed—creating a full auditable record from proposal to closure. [Close Projects]

Roles & Permissions: Module-level access control for every user. Permissions cascade logically across all stages. Approver rights are granted independently of all other access levels.[ Read · Create · Edit · Delete · Approve — configured per module]

overview.title: Budget Management & Financial Oversight
overview.description: CSR budgets are allocated at the project level, distributed across regions, released in phases, and reported against regulatory obligations. Without a structured system, reconciliation happens after the fact — long after the chance to course-correct has passed.

list.list: Budget Allocation: Set the total approved budget at the master project level and distribute it across PSN regions. Every allocation is logged from the moment it's entered.
Phased Disbursements: Release funds in tranches tied to project milestones. Every release requires a corresponding approval and documented record — no bulk disbursements without evidence of progress.
Utilization Tracking: Track spend against allocation in real time. Flag underutilization before year-end and catch overruns before they become compliance issues.
Budget Approvals: Revisions and reallocation requests follow the same structured approval flow as project proposals—versioned, approved, and auditable.
Document-Linked Expenditure: Every disbursement requires supporting documents — invoices, receipts, utilization certificates. Undocumented spending does not move forward

overview.title: The Budget Dashboard
overview.description: One screen. Complete financial visibility across every active and closed CSR initiative.

list.list: Total Budget Sanctioned: A consolidated view of the aggregate approved budget across all active projects for the financial year — the single source of truth for total CSR commitment.
Committed vs. Disbursed: A clear split between what has been allocated to projects and what has actually been released to partners — instantly revealing the gap between intention and execution.
Utilization Rate by Project: Tracks the percentage of budget utilized per project, with RAG status indicators — On Track, At Risk, or Overrun — so problem areas are visible before they escalate.
Region-wise Budget Split: Breaks down PSN-level allocation and utilization across geographies—giving regional performance a financial face across the entire program.
Pending Disbursements: Lists all approved milestones awaiting fund release, with overdue items flagged—so nothing stays stuck in the pipeline without someone being accountable for it.
Underspend Alerts: Surface projects nearing year-end with significant unspent allocation—giving finance and CSR teams enough time to act before the window closes.
Top NGO Partners by Spend: Highlights the highest-funded partners alongside their utilization certificate status—linking money released to documented evidence of utilization.
Compliance Spend Tracker: Tracks the percentage of mandated CSR spend utilized against regulatory requirements — the one number that matters most when reporting season arrives.

overview.title: CSR activity initiation to certificate issuance.
overview.description: The volunteering process is fully digital — from the manager triggering the activity notification to the employee receiving their participation certificate.

list.list: Manager sets up the activity—selects NGO, links project, schedules it, and notifies employees
Employees receive alerts—activity appears on their dashboard
Employees register and apply via the CSR dashboard for approval
Supervisor reviews requests—approves or rejects nominations
Participants submit post-activity details—log contributions after the event
Manager validates participation—reviews and confirms submissions
Certificates issued—approved participants receive digital certificates

overview.title: One project. Multiple locations. Full visibility.
overview.description: PSN allows a single CSR project to be implemented across multiple geographic regions, each with its own details, budget, and tracking — all connected to the master project record.

list.list: Create a project with PSN—add the first region during setup
View PSN regions—all entries listed with status by region
Add new regions—link additional regions to an existing project
Edit region details—update PSN records as needed
Track and report centrally—region data rolls up to the main project

key_features.title: ROLES & PERMISSIONS
key_features.description: The relevant access for every user in the process. Permissions are module-level and role-specific — not one-size-fits-all. The default for any user, including Super Admin, is read-only. Every elevated permission is granted deliberately, per module. [Note: Approver rights are special — they must be granted manually and sit independent of all other permission levels, regardless of role.]

list.feature: Drives projects and activities and validates participation data. Holds the broadest operational access — creating, editing, and managing records across the lifecycle.
Runs regional activities and verifies submissions at the PSN level. Access is scoped to their geography while remaining connected to the master project record.
Reviews and approves employee registrations for volunteering activities. Nomination approval rights are granted independently — not bundled with other access levels.
Browses open activities, registers for participation, submits post-activity details, and tracks personal certificates. Access is purposefully limited to what's relevant to them.

how_it_works.title: What Is Document Lifecycle & Workflow Management?
how_it_works.description: A fully customized web application designed to manage documents from creation to archival, while automating approvals, tracking every action, and ensuring compliance at every stage of the document lifecycle.

list.list: One Repository. Every Document—All organisational documents are stored in a single, secure location—no scattered files, no version confusion, and no searching across systems.
Approvals That Move Without Being Chased—Multi-level approval workflows run automatically—the right person is notified at the right stage, every time, without manual follow-up.
Always Know Where a Document Stands— Real-time visibility into document status, ownership, and history—so no one has to ask for an update or wait for one.
A Record That Holds Up Under Scrutiny—Complete, tamper-proof audit trails on every action—ensuring full transparency and a compliance record that's ready when it's needed most.

how_it_works.title: From scattered chaos to structured control.
how_it_works.description: We don’t hand you a generic tool and expect you to adapt to it. Instead, we understand your existing workflows and build a system tailored around them—ensuring the solution fits your processes, not the other way around.

list.list: Requirement Analysis & Workflow Mapping—  A detailed assessment of your current document workflows, approval hierarchies, user roles, and compliance requirements
Solution Design & UX Planning —  Designing workflows, approval structures, and user experiences that align seamlessly with your organization’s internal processes.
Custom Development—  A fully tailored solution built to your specifications — not a generic platform with minimal customization.
Testing & Quality Assurance—  Comprehensive testing in collaboration with your team to ensure reliability, accuracy, and readiness before launch.
Deployment & Go-Live—  Flexible deployment options, including cloud, on-premise, or hybrid environments, based on your infrastructure needs.
User Training & Ongoing Support—  Hands-on training and continuous support to ensure smooth adoption and long-term success with the system.

key_features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don’t.
key_features.description: Built for organisations that handle documents seriously—from the front-line employee creating a draft to the senior executive signing off.

list.feature: Fine-grained control over who can create, view, approve, or modify. Each role sees exactly what they need—nothing more.
Single or multi-level approvals with conditional routing. Documents move automatically — no chasing, no follow-up emails.
Always know where a document stands, who has it, and how long it has been sitting there. Full visibility at every stage.
Track approval timelines, spot bottlenecks, and prove compliance on demand, not scrambled together before an audit.
Connects with your core banking system, ERP, HR platforms, and identity management tools. No isolated islands
Every action logged — who did what, when, and why. Tamper-proof records that make audits genuinely straightforward.
